description: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.The Community You Will Join: Airbnb is seeking an Advanced Analytics Intern to join the Finance Data Science & Strategy team within the Finance organization for the 2027 Summer Intern Program. The Finance Data Science & Strategy team builds the statistical models behind Airbnb’s top line forecast and explains how the business performs against it. The work runs as a loop. We figure out where actuals differ from forecast and why, share the answer with partners across Finance and the business, and feed what we learned into the next version of the forecast, so each cycle starts from a better baseline than the last. We are looking for someone curious about business and data, who can understand both the ‘what’ and the ‘why’ behind a number and help translate them into decisions. An ideal candidate would have some familiarity with analytical methodologies, BI tooling, and business communication. The Difference You Will Make: As an Advanced Analytics Intern on our team, you’ll help explain how the business performed against the forecast and use what you find to improve it. You’ll have the opportunity to: Build comprehensive and high quality analyses of how the business is performing against the forecast, and explain what drove the difference Work with the team’s data scientists to turn those findings into improvements in the next version of the forecast Communicate findings clearly to partners across Finance and the business, in written readouts and recurring reviews A Typical Day: During your internship you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our incredible employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during the summer. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our business, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel. You’ll be expected to: Own and complete a capstone project from beginning to end Collaborate with multiple team members to achieve project milestones Communicate with stakeholders across different teams to provide project updates Seek and provide feedback throughout the internship Actively participate in and contribute to the Finance Data Science & Strategy team and broader Airbnb community Your Expertise: This opportunity is for full-time students completing a Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Data Science, Mathematics, Analytics, Statistics, Econometrics, etc.) with at least one semester of school remaining after the internship. Proficient in communication and collaboration, with the ability to effectively engage with diverse teams and individuals Skilled in conducting thorough and inclusive analyses, ensuring that findings are communicated clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Possesses robust data, statistical analysis, and analytics skills, contributing to a comprehensive understanding of complex datasets. Substantial experience in SQL, along with a solid foundation in at least one programming language (Python or R) Preferred (not required): Familiarity with forecasting, time series, and/or A/B testing Demonstrated interest in high growth, technology, and/or hospitality companies Work authorization for employment in the United States is required (CPT/OPT with 2-year STEM extension is accepted) Your Location: This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Equal Employment Opportunity: Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. The Communications team at Airbnb is responsible for telling our story around the world. Whether we are briefing press on inspiring travel trends, highlighting unique experiences led by local hosts, or explaining how travel on our platform benefits local families and communities, we are the voice of Airbnb on a broad range of topics. We're a fast growing and high energy team with a passion for people, places and great stories. If you'd like to be part of one of the world's greatest communications teams, come tell us your story. Press Relations: Assist in the creation of press releases and press kits, including storytelling ideation, coordinating with agencies to format materials into press kits, drafting press releases, and developing additional supporting creative assets. Coordinate with agency partners on local communication initiatives, media plans, strategic announcements, and other media-related topics. Overview internal reporting workflows such as populating weekly reports for France, and keeping the communication calendars up-to-date. Conduct key analyses using internal monitoring tools or by coordinating with internal data teams. Coordinate external communication initiatives, including outreach to Airbnb hosts and coordination with external agencies. Help develop comms pitches, from sourcing and vetting Airbnb listings with hosts to drafting pitches for regional press around local events. Attend and help organise press conferences and various events. Tour de France: Roadshow with local press (media briefings). Support influencer logistics, including listing vetting and reporting A typical day: As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Review internal media monitoring tools to compile reports and analyze brand and competitor social media for insights. Create and update project tracking tools, slide decks, documents, and compile editorial press pitches and Newsroom posts. Support discussions with agencies, draft releases, emails to partners, or other project-related content under senior consumer manager supervision. Participate in and support internal coordination meetings with other functions and departments. Analyze social media performance for brand and influencer partners, prepare metrics and reports, and assist in talent consultant needs, team coordination, and scheduling meetings. Actively participate in and contribute to the Communications and broader Airbnb community Use AI tools to speed up drafting, research and reporting, always checking outputs for accuracy and brand voice. The team works at the intersection of sales, product, operations, and community, helping hosts create unique moments of connection for guests. Our mission is to raise the quality and reliability of Experiences while supporting sustainable growth in priority markets. We partner closely with local teams, product specialists, and central operations to strengthen host success and ensure the best on-platform experience for guests. Supporting day to day operations, such as host requests, listing updates, review removal requests and guest cases, and organising host calls, workshops and events. Why join us Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.The Brex Internship Program Throughout this 1–2 year program, you'll be placed within one of our G&A teams, learning about areas such as risk management, finance, automation, and data analysis. You'll contribute to critical process improvements and developments, implementing our processes while leveraging AI to streamline workflows and enhance decision-making. You'll challenge the status quo and improve cross-team communication and efficiency. We believe in a founder mindset — and this program is designed to show you how you can take ownership of your growth. During this program, you'll complete a core project focused on key data insights, process implementation, or process improvement—many of which will involve exploring and applying AI solutions. You'll then have the opportunity to share your findings with your program class and Brex Executives. The program is supported by our leadership team, and you'll have frequent meetings with various Brex leaders. This provides a unique opportunity to work closely with and learn from executives who are at the forefront of building an AI-native company. Responsibilities Handle day-to-day tasks efficiently. Analyze business inefficiencies and propose process improvements to leadership, leveraging AI to drive solutions. Work cross-functionally with various teams to streamline processes and create AI-powered workflows that improve automation and decision-making. Collaborate with EPD, G&A, GTM, and Legal to translate business needs into practical automation solutions. Contribute to the long-term strategy for Brex's AI-native roadmap, exploring and integrating new tools and frameworks to enhance internal operations. Requirements Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree with graduation between December 2027 - December 2028. Demonstrated experience using AI tools and applying effective prompting skills. Strong problem-solving abilities and comfort working through ambiguity. Passion for business operations, internal tools, and the application of AI and automation to improve efficiency and enable scale. Proven ability to work both independently and in cross-functional teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly and effectively. Desire to contribute in a fast-paced environment with a founding team member mindset. Where you'll work This role will be fully remote based in São Paulo. There will be some training required in our São Paulo office. Basic knowledge or proficiency in programming languages such as but not limited to Python, JavaScript, or SQL. Experience with personal projects, a portfolio of work, or participation in competitions (e.g., Hackathons) focused on AI, machine learning, or data analysis. Leadership roles in university clubs or organizations related to data science, AI, computer science, or business analytics. Prior internships in an operational, data, or technical role, especially where you were involved in process improvement or automation. Familiarity with Retool, Salesforce, Hex, and Looker. About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.Available locations: Austin, TX San Francisco, CA Available Term Winter (January - April 2027) About the Role Cloudflare's HR/AI Transformation team makes HR work simpler and more effective. We redesign how work gets done, build internal tools (including AI tools), and run learning programs that help people adopt new ways of working. As our intern working on programs and processes, you'll help run those learning programs, keep our projects on track, and turn people's challenges into clear problem statements and process maps. You'll work directly with the head of AI Transformation & People Strategy, alongside HR leaders, process owners and engineers. This internship starts in January 2027 and is designed for a current student who is highly organized, writes clearly and is curious about how AI can improve the way people work. Responsibilities Plan and run our learning programs, including scheduling sessions, coordinating speakers and materials, and sending announcements and follow-ups. Maintain a single, up-to-date view of all team projects, and follow up with project owners to keep work moving. Write short, clear status updates for team leaders and stakeholders. Meet with people across the HR function to understand their challenges, and summarize what you learn in clear problem statements. Document how key processes work today, and help prepare workshops to redesign them. Own one project from start to finish, with a named sponsor and a clean handoff at the end of your internship. Requirements Currently enrolled in a program studying business or similar. Experience planning and managing projects or programs. Strong written communication, including the ability to turn a messy conversation into a clear, simple summary. Strong organization and follow-through across many people, details and deadlines. Confidence working with senior leaders and reaching out to people you haven't met. Hands-on experience using AI tools in your work or studies. Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship. In office 3-5 days a week. Nice-to-Have Skills Background in consulting, operations, HR or process improvement. Experience with process mapping, user research or workshop facilitation. Familiarity with capacity planning and project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana or Smartsheet. CompensationCompensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated hourly rate of $27.00/hr.What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! description: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.Build the operational and technical skill set that runs global trade At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with technology and people who understand it end to end. The Rotational Development Program (RDP) exists because that combination — real supply chain fluency plus the ability to build and automate — doesn't exist at scale in the market today. So we're building it ourselves. This is an 18-month program, not a rotation for rotation's sake. Every assignment is live, revenue-generating work. Every participant leaves with a certification in AI and low-code tooling running alongside their operational and commercial training. And every graduate places into a role with real scope: primarily Account Management, with paths into Automation Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering/Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a traditional Ops/Sales/Customs track. What you'll do You'll rotate through three functions, six months each, with AI/low-code curriculum running continuously across all three: Gateway Ops (Air or Ocean). Own the shipment lifecycle. Execute bookings, manage exceptions, and hold data integrity to Flexport's standard. Build your first automation and reporting skills through structured coursework running in parallel. Customs. Become a global trade expert by navigating the complex world of customs regulations to ensure goods comply with international laws. Simultaneously, move into applied technical work: SQL, workflow automation, Lean process improvement, etc. Sales / Account Management. Take on go-to-market work and build client-facing skills, operating with more independence. Your capstone: identify a real business problem in the function you're sitting in and build the tooling or process fix that solves it. You'll present it to leadership at graduation. Throughout the program, you'll get: A day-to-day manager in your current rotation and a Rotation Program Manager tracking your development, with mid-point and end-of-rotation evaluations at every stage. Certifications in AI/low-code tooling, from foundational bootcamp through applied builds to a capstone project. Bi-weekly cohort touchpoints and a standing alumni mentor community. Increased earning potential as you clear program benchmarks This role is for you if you Are on track to graduate, or recently graduated, and want to build a career at the intersection of supply chain operations and technology — not just run one or the other. Are genuinely curious about AI and low-code tooling and want to build real fluency, not just check a resume box. Can operate with minimal supervision, prioritize a high volume of work, and communicate clearly under pressure. Want real ownership fast? This program hands you live client and business work from the very beginning — it is not a shadowing or classroom based program. Have a "compliance-first" mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and that matters in every rotation. Ready to build the future of global trade — and the skill set to run it? Apply now. role: Automation Scientist Graduate Intern, RAC Operations
description: Our mission is to make biology easier to engineer. Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe’s growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Our bioengineers make use of an in-house automated foundry for designing and building new organisms. The role is based out of Ginkgo’s Boston, MA location and requires regular in-person attendance. About the Role: Ginkgo Bioworks is deploying a massive fleet of Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs)—modular, mobile robotic units that snap together like LEGOs to form an autonomous lab. We are looking for an Automation Scientist Intern to be the hands-on force behind this fleet. You will learn how to load, operate, take down, analyze and troubleshoot protocol runs on the most advanced lab automation hardware in the world, pushing our "Nebula" frontier lab towards autonomous operation. Responsibilities: Master the RAC Platform: Learn to operate and maintain a system of Reconfigurable Automation Carts, designed to support a variety of molecular and cell biology scientific workflows. You will queue and submit programmatically-generated protocols, monitor execution of your protocol runs, and retrieve and analyze protocol run data. Over time, you will advance to modifying or writing new protocols for our autonomous lab. Learn Biology: You will prepare and onboard reagents and consumables for upcoming molecular and cell biology scientific workflows, execute such workflows, and take down and offboard used plates from completed workflows. In the process, you will learn how to do scientifically rigorous experimental design, execution and data analysis as well as how to optimize scientific workflows for running on RAC automation. Preferred Qualifications: Recent graduate (BS/MS) or expected 2026 or H1 2027 graduation date in Computer Science, Bioengineering, Computational Biology, or Bioinformatics. Chemical, Mechanical or Electrical Engineers with computational skills and a strong interest in learning biology are also welcome. "Automation-forward" mindset: you love working with lab automation and making robotic systems run smoother. Willingness to do whatever it takes to ensure that existing and new scientific workflows run successfully on our RAC automation system. Bonus (not required): Interest in communications, marketing, social media, and/or short form video The base salary range for this role is $37,700-$53,500. Actual pay within this range will depend on a candidate's skills, expertise, and experience. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental & vision coverage, health spending accounts, voluntary benefits, leave of absence policies, 8 paid holidays in addition to a full-week winter shutdown and unlimited Paid Time Off policy. *It is expected that all Internships are onsite five days a week. It is the policy of Ginkgo Bioworks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees, employment applicants, and EOE disability/vet. Privacy Notice I understand that I am applying for employment with Ginkgo Bioworks and am being asked to provide information in connection with my application. I further understand that Ginkgo gathers this information through a third-party service provider and that Ginkgo may also use other service providers to assist in the application process. Ginkgo may share my information with such third-party service providers in connection with my application and for the start of employment. Ginkgo will treat my information in accordance with Ginkgo's Privacy Policy. By submitting this job application, I am acknowledging that I have reviewed and agree to Ginkgo's Privacy Policy as well as the privacy policies of the third-party service providers used by Ginkgo's associated with the application process.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. Lyft Urban Solutions designs, builds, and operates bikeshare systems in more than 50 cities worldwide, including New York, Chicago, London, Barcelona, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro, and Montréal. Our Longueuil facility is the birthplace of BIXI, North America's first automated bikeshare system, and today builds the bikes and stations behind some of the world's largest bikeshare networks. We are looking for a Hardware Field Quality Engineer Intern to join our Field Quality team at our Longueuil facility. Once our bikes, e-bikes, batteries, and stations leave the factory, Field Quality owns how they hold up in the real world: millions of rides, all four seasons, in cities across the globe. You will work alongside field quality engineers to help spot emerging hardware issues, investigate their root cause, and support fixes with engineering, manufacturing, and market operations teams. You will spend time hands-on with failed parts in the lab, and just as much time in the data working out how big a problem really is. Responsibilities: Support failure analysis on parts returned from the field, including requests from enterprise customers, by helping with teardown, inspection, and electrical testing and documenting findings with photos. Help monitor field data, such as vehicle and station alerts and repair records, and flag emerging issues to the team. Build and update dashboards and queries that track reliability metrics and retrofit progress. Assist with field retrofit campaigns by helping identify affected units and tracking progress. Help review repair SOPs and troubleshooting guides used by market mechanics, and suggest improvements. Contribute to field failure investigations in Jira, working with engineers on root cause and corrective actions. role: Software Engineer, Intern - Connectivity Platform and Product
description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role The Connectivity team builds products that connect our most critical institutions to their most critical data. Our products securely integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. We build applications, frameworks, and infrastructure for connectivity across Foundry: high scale data processing pipelines, user-written code, AI agents, or connecting directly from the Ontology. You’ll work across the stack, owning and building out features across our UI, backend services, and compute platforms. You’ll iterate closely with experienced engineers, FDEs, and other teams to scope and build out new Connectivity products and integrations, as well as building toolkits to support those integrations: APIs, SDKs, authentication flows, security frameworks, and changes to core products across the platform. The work is highly technical, collaborative, dynamic, and follows customer signal closely. This role is expected to be about 75% backend and 25% frontend. Core Responsibilities We're hiring high agency engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems. If you’re motivated to enable outcomes with connectivity, here are some examples of the types of work you’d get to do: Build SDKs and integrations that allow customers and internal product teams to write code to connect to external systemsLaunch features to enable entirely new paradigms of data connectionDive deep into Foundry security and the bleeding edge of securing connected AI agents and pipelines in sensitive environmentsIdentify, diagnose, and remediate performance and correctness issues for high scale connectivity workflowsWork with infrastructure teams to expose powerful networking functionality to usersCraft elegant workflows to enable customers to maximally leverage their data systemsScale nascent connectivity products from first use to billionsLearn and build across a large suite of repos, services, and domains Technologies We Use Java and PythonOpen-source technologies like Cassandra, Kubernetes, Envoy, GraphQL, and ReactProtocols such as TCP, UDP, TLS, HTTPGradle for builds and GitHub for collaborationShared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms You do not need prior experience with these technologies. We expect you to learn them here.

Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the teams Stripe’s Controllership organization is responsible for the accurate and timely recording of Stripe’s business activities, the integrity of our financial reporting, and the scalable processes and controls that support our growth. We partner across Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand Stripe’s products and operations, resolve complex financial issues, and maintain a strong control environment. We are hiring four Controllership Interns, with one role on each of the following teams: Accounts Receivable (AR), Controls, Product Accounting, and Corporate Accounting. In any placement, you’ll work with experienced teammates and cross-functional partners on meaningful accounting, data, systems, controls, or process-improvement work. Accounts Receivable (AR) supports invoicing, collections, cash application, and related financial operations through scalable, accurate, and auditable processes. Controls supports Stripe’s internal-control environment by documenting and assessing processes, identifying risks, supporting control testing, and helping teams design sustainable improvements. Product Accounting supports Stripe’s products by understanding their financial-data flows, evaluating accounting implications, and developing scalable processes Corporate Accounting supports Stripe’s close, financial reporting, corporate accounting processes, and control environment What you’ll do We’re looking for graduate students who want to deliver outsized impact while accelerating their growth in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You’ll apply classroom learning to important accounting and financial-data problems at an industry leader in fintech. You’ll support meaningful work with an impact on Stripe and its users, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Depending on your placement, you may: Support core Controllership activities based on your placement, including accounts receivable operations, monthly and quarterly close, financial reporting, product accounting, or internal controls Prepare or support journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, variance analysis, and other accounting deliverables Analyze large financial and operational datasets using Google Sheets, SQL, AI tools, or other systems to identify unusual activity, data-quality issues, reconciliation breaks, control gaps, or operational trends Support invoicing, collections, cash application, or related order-to-cash processes, where relevant to your placement Research accounting questions and prepare clear supporting documentation under the guidance of experienced accountants Assist with the design, documentation, testing, and improvement of accounting processes and internal controls Support financial reporting, management analysis, and internal or external audit requests Partner with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Product, Operations, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand business activities and resolve issues Drive continuous process improvement, standardization, simplification, automation, and reporting enhancements Complete and present a case study or scoped project to your team and the broader Controllership organization Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Currently enrolled at an accredited university pursuing a master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field Coursework, a project, or practical experience demonstrating a foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial statements Strong knowledge of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office tools, including experience analyzing large datasets Experience using SQL to query, analyze, and validate data through coursework, projects, or practical work Excellent written and verbal communication and organizational skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguous opportunities in a fast-moving environment A self-starter who can drive results, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines A solution-oriented mindset and enthusiasm for establishing best practices Ability to build strong, collaborative working relationships with business partners Preferred qualifications Coursework or experience in Intermediate Accounting, audit, technical accounting, information systems, or data analytics Experience with Python, data visualization, or dashboarding tools such as Power BI or Tableau Familiarity with an ERP, financial-reporting, or workflow-automation tool Experience using AI for financial analysis or process improvement Interest in payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, digital assets, or technology Experience documenting a process or presenting analytical findings

location: New York, Seattle, South San Francisco HQ
description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. About the team Our Data Science team partners deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. We're looking for data scientists with a passion for analyzing data, building machine learning and statistical models, and running experiments to drive impact. Our Fraud, Losses, and Financial Crime Data Science team builds the models and data products that protect Stripe and its users from fraud, account takeover, and financial crime. We own the full fraud and loss modeling stack - from account takeover detection and card fraud classification to merchant-level loss estimation, unsupervised anomaly detection, and financial crime risk modeling. We partner with Fraud Engineering, Financial Crimes Engineering, and Risk Operations to bring these systems into production and ensure they have measurable impact on Stripe's financial integrity and user trust. What you’ll do As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. You'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. Responsibilities Applying probability distributions, statistical inference, and hypothesis testing to quantify uncertainty and evaluate business outcomes Using Python or R for data analysis, data processing, visualizations, statistical modeling, machine learning, predictive analytics, automation, and implementing causal inference and experimental analyses Building, training, and evaluating predictive models across regression and classification tasks for bias-variance trade-offs and model selection Modeling temporal dependencies, seasonality, and trend decomposition to generate and evaluate time-series predictions Identifying structural patterns, clusters, and outliers in unlabeled data Deploying models in production and adjusting model thresholds to improve performance Designing, running, and analyzing complex experiments and leveraging causal inference designs Using SQL and Spark to create, transform, and analyze large datasets Learn quickly by asking great questions, finding how to work with your mentor and teammates effectively, and communicating the status of your work clearly Present your work to the Data Science team, partner teams, and fellow interns. Who you are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum requirements Enrolled in a quantitative PhD program (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) with the expectation of graduating in December 2027 or spring/summer 2028 Experience with SQL and a scientific computing language (such as Python, R, etc.) Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding Experience communicating and collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a team environment Preferred qualifications Experience writing and debugging data pipelines Demonstrated ability to evaluate and receive feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders via experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects Ability to learn new systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you’re a software engineer or researcher who’s curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you. Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship! You will: Launch features that directly improve Waymo's driving behavior in highly dynamic and challenging environments. Work closely with onboard engineers to apply latest techniques to integrate and validate large ML models in real-time production systems. You have: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field. Experience with C++ and Python. Strong understanding of data structures and problem solving skills. We prefer: Experience applying machine learning to solve computer vision, motion planning or related robotics problems. Experience with Data structures, algorithms, etc. Experience using Machine Learning core concepts. Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below.
